title: Large induced subgraphs with $k$ vertices of maximum degree
summary: We prove that, for every integer $k\ge 2$, there exists a constant $c_k>0$ such that every graph on $n\ge R(k,k)$ vertices with maximum degree $Δ$ contains an induced subgraph on at least $n-c_k\sqrtΔ$ vertices whose maximum degree is attained by at least $k$ vertices. This confirms a conjecture of Caro and Yuster in strong form.
